ideas.title: Investigating the Letterkenny Army Depot Incident
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the death of a Biglerville teen at Letterkenny Army Depot and explore potential connections to other incidents.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the death of the Biglerville teen?
Are there any connections to other incidents at the Letterkenny Army Depot?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of negligence or misconduct at the Letterkenny Army Depot. By investigating the circumstances surrounding the death of the Biglerville teen, we may be able to identify systemic issues that need to be addressed.
